rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the edible walnut nut.

example.english: I ate a walnut this morning.

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the walnut tree rather than its nuts.

example.english: That walnut tree produces lots of walnuts every year.

rows.note: Use this specifically for wood or timber from a walnut tree.

example.english: This table is made of walnut wood.
